verdict: FAIL - measurement insufficient, model NOT installed
why: At 50 cm the direct tone dominates the microphone (peak about -13 dBFS), so the loop contribution is not resolvable: bypass is 0.04 dB BELOW open.
With no resolvable feedback boost the three-point cannot show whether cancellation works, so the entry refuses to install - which is what the captain required.
CD 0.49 dB at this level also says the fitted prediction carries no useful information at this working point.
conclusion: 50 cm is outside the regime this acceptance test can evaluate, at least at tone peaks around -13 dBFS. This is a measurement-range limit (direct coupling swamps the loop), not evidence that cancellation failed.
next_if_wanted: A different stimulus (much louder tone, or the loop measured with the direct path separated) would be needed to evaluate 50 cm; that is a new measurement design, not a config tweak.
